function _N({ api: e, install: t, publish: n, path: a = "/api/admin/base-map/atlas", decode: o = (r) => createImageBitmap(r) }) {

  async function d() {
    if (!r) return;
    const u = r.editorAssets?.seasonAtlases?.[s];
    if (!u || !/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(u.sha256) || !Number.isSafeInteger(u.byteLength) || u.byteLength < 1 || u.byteLength > 4 * 1024 * 1024) {
      n({ atlasError: "圖集描述無效", atlasLoading: !1 });
      return;
    }

    i = b;

      if (h !== l) return;
      if (p.bytes.length !== u.byteLength || p.sha256 !== u.sha256) throw new Error("圖集長度或摘要不符");
      const m = Array.from(new Uint8Array(await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", p.bytes)), (w) => w.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("");
      if (h !== l) return;

      const v = await o(new Blob([p.bytes], { type: "image/png" }));
      if (h !== l) {
        v.close();
        return;
      }
      if (v.width !== 256 || v.height !== 256)
        throw v.close(), new Error("圖集尺寸無效");
      c = v, t(c);
    } catch (p) {
      h === l && (i = null, n({ atlasError: p.message }));
    } finally {
      h === l && n({ atlasLoading: !1 });
    }
  }
  return Object.freeze({
    setSource(u) {
      if (r = u, r) return d();
      l++, i = null, t(null), c?.close(), c = null, n({ atlasLoading: !1, atlasError: "", season: s });
    },

      return s = u, d();
    },

}

    render: () => c?.render(),
    setIdentity(m) {
      if (s === m && i === (m?.version ?? null)) {
        c?.setIdentity(m);
        return;
      }
      c?.dispose(), c = null, l = null, s = m, i = m?.version ?? null, g(h() ? o.current() : null), c?.setIdentity(m);
    },
    dispose() {
      c?.dispose(), c = null, u = null, b = null;
    }
  });
}
